title: AI Model Releases by Lab Over Time
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Capability Tracking
description: Stacked area chart of quarterly AI model releases broken down by lab, showing the field getting more crowded since November 2022.

learningObjectives: Read a stacked area chart with many series
Distinguish growth in total volume from growth in competitive crowding

keyQuestions: Which labs have entered the frontier-model race since 2022?
Is one lab pulling away, or is the field getting more competitive?
commonMisconceptions: Assuming a rising total stack means every lab is growing equally, when a few labs may dominate the increase
assessmentOpportunities: Ask learners to identify the quarter a specific lab first appears and discuss why

dataSource.name: AI Release Tracker
dataSource.note: Chart values live in ../ai-release-data/data.json, shared with five other MicroSims.
